frontier: On the deterministic square L=9, p=0.20, q=1, seed=12 sample, which factor vertices and edges dominate the late-iteration message residual, and is the failure a fixed residual floor or an oscillatory cycle?
Only after Phase C0 may one bounded convergence intervention be preregistered; increasing max_iterations alone does not count as improved convergence.
Regenerate the affected Lab 002 matched logical comparisons with posterior LLR before claiming herald benefit or Relay-versus-damping LER differences.
Separate still-usable BP-only convergence, calibration, and runtime diagnostics from invalidated MWPM logical outcomes.
The q-by-p finite-size operational boundary is now owned by Lab 003.
A new memory-assisted BP design would require a separate, pre-registered ablation after the retained BP-only convergence and calibration diagnostics.
resolved: C8 cached edge products fail the registered equivalence gate: 13 square and 15 honeycomb observations fail, including one correction and three iteration disagreements. Timing is skipped and the candidate is rejected.
C7 preallocated-buffer residual priority is bit-identical to the validated stable-sort kernel on both C6 streams but slower by 0.85 ms on square and 0.053 ms on honeycomb, so it remains disabled.

C6 fresh end-to-end confirmation reproduces the square convergence gain (+15.6 points) but finds stable-sort residual priority slower on square by 1.63 ms and honeycomb by 0.29 ms. All corrections are syndrome faithful and neither geometry has a paired logical rescue or harm.

C5 stable residual sorting preserves the scan schedule bit for bit on 64 square observations and reduces mean compiled inference time by 2.01 ms (95% interval -4.27 to -0.29); it has not yet been compared with synchronous Numba under one common protocol.
The accelerated 15-test LLR regression preflight passes. It locks signed LLR weights in both decoder classes and the square L=9, p=0.20, q=1, seed=12 right-chain selection on edges 123-126.

Phase C0 reproduced the seed-12 trace bit-identically with the production Python recurrence. The max message residual decays from 1.32e-2 at iteration 20 to 4.69e-3 at 40 and 2.16e-3 at 80, far above 1e-8; the two-step residual is about twice the one-step residual, so this sample shows slow drift rather than a period-2 cycle.

The convergence investigation begins with a measurement-only trace of the frozen damping recurrence: global max message delta, per-factor and per-edge residuals, belief drift, factor-variable marginal inconsistency, and period-2 oscillation amplitude by iteration. It changes no decoder output and authorizes no parameter sweep.

The old -log P(error) projection was an incorrect MWPM interface. All Lab 002 LER, rescue/introduction, and logical-comparison conclusions produced with weight_rule=negative_log are invalidated; historical files are provenance only.
The unqualified herald is a fusion-remnant vertex witness, not an erasure/loss location.
The syndrome-only baseline and every reweighted completion use the maintained pymatching package; this Lab does not implement MWPM.
A syndrome-BP plus PyMatching ablation separates BP-only gains from herald-information gains.
Tiny graphs use exact posterior enumeration as a logical-class accuracy oracle.
The first benchmark set p_m=p_h=0, but every negative-log MWPM logical outcome from it is invalidated.

The interactive workbench exposes observation, posterior, herald-induced posterior shift, correction-versus-truth attribution, proper soft scores, syndrome-density diagnostics, recurrence diagnostics, and per-edge inference values on one deterministic sample.

Soft BP does not change syndrome density or apply a correction; its standalone contribution is evaluated through proper posterior scores, while logical contribution is evaluated through matched decoder ablations.
Operational p_eff is defined by inverting the finite-size static-MWPM logical-error curve rather than by using gauge-dependent residual edge density.

The unified Lab 002 decoder and interactive artifact use recurrence_mode=damping by researcher direction; recurrence_mode=memory is an explicit experimental mode. The old negative-log A/B cannot establish their relative corrected-LLR logical performance.

The retained memory-recurrence evidence is BP-only: under the tested configuration it worsened proper posterior scores, selected no converged candidate, and cost more runtime. Its old LER comparisons are invalid.
